chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Rifa'ah, who said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the man who performs the Obligatory Tawaf after Asr prayer, should he pray the two cycles when he finishes from his Tawaf? He (peace be upon him) said: 'Yes.' Have not the words of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) reached you: 'O children of Abd al-Muttalib! Do not prevent the people from the Prayer after Asr, lest you prevent them from the Tawaf.'

key_terms.بَنُو عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ: The children of Abd al-Muttalib (Prophet's clan)
key_terms.صَلَاةُ التَّوَافِ: The prayer of Tawaf (implied by context)

ai.seo_question: When should one pray the two cycles of Tawaf after performing the Obligatory Tawaf?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) validates performing the two cycles of Tawaf prayer after Asr by citing the Prophetic tradition 'O people of Abd al-Muttalib, do not prevent people from praying after Asr, so do not prevent them from Tawaf,' which establishes Tawaf as a distinct act of worship rather than a mere extension of prayer. This ruling is significant in Shia jurisprudence as it clarifies the permissibility of Tawaf and its associated prayer during the time of Asr, distinguishing it from the general prohibition of 'no prayer after Asr' which typically refers to voluntary prayers not linked to a specific act like Tawaf or Fajr. The hadith underscores the continuity of ritual purity and devotion, linking the physical act of circumambulation with the spiritual discipline of prayer.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Rafa’at who said,

‘I asked Abu Abdullahasws about the man who performs Tawaaf, the Obligatory Tawaaf after Al-Asr, should he Pray the two Cycles where he is free from his Tawaaf. Heasws said: ‘Yes. Have not the words of Rasool-Allahsaww reached you: ‘O children of Abdul Muttalibas! Do not prevent the people from the Prayer after Al-Asr, for you would be preventing them from the Tawaaf’.
en.sarwar: 7. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Rifa’ah who has said the following: “I once asked abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about a man who performs obligatory Tawaf after al-‘ Asr; if he can perform the two Rak‘at Salat (prayer) after Tawaf when he completes his Tawaf. He (the Imam) said, ‘Yes, he can do so.

Has it not come to your notice that the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause,’ said, “O children of ‘Abd al-Muttalib, you must not prevent people from performing Salat (prayer) after al-‘Asr, because in so doing you prevent them from performing Tawaf.’””
